rawScenePlan.title: Ledger Aisles
rawScenePlan.event: The central atrium's retail geometry folds like a giant index: freestanding display islands compress into stacked filing drawers and long aisles retract into neat horizontal tiers. Drawers slide out in sequence; one low drawer sticks half-open and a thin, glossy smear streaks its lip.
rawScenePlan.consequence: One low filing-drawer left half-open with a fresh glossy smear across its lip.
rawScenePlan.nextHook: the glossy smear on the drawer lip trails away toward the nearest escalator
rawScenePlan.stillPrompt: Wide, static view of the Kaufhaus atrium as the store architecture collapses into stacked, drawer-like aisles; multiple drawers slide like cabinet rows; foreground drawer left half-open, a pale glossy smear across its lip catching cool overhead light.
rawScenePlan.videoPrompt: 5s sequence: slow, mechanical folding of display islands into stacked drawers; synchronized sliding of drawers; the camera cranes down as one drawer sticks half-open and a glossy smear beads along its edge; ambient, low industrial hum.
rawScenePlan.cameraCue: After the folding completes, crane down and hold on the half-open drawer to reveal the smear.

rawScenePlan.title: Fleshy Catalogue
rawScenePlan.event: The index cards and thin catalogue slivers inside the stuck drawer soften and thicken: paper becomes warm, pale swatches that pulse once and exude fibrous, wet strands. A single strand lashes out and adheres to the nearest escalator step, leaving a damp, stringy trail leading upward.
rawScenePlan.consequence: A damp, fibrous trail running from the drawer across the floor and up an escalator step.
rawScenePlan.nextHook: the fibrous trail releases tiny laminated strips that float upward into the air
rawScenePlan.stillPrompt: Tight close-up of a drawer interior where paper index cards visibly thicken into pale, pulsing swatches; one strand of wet fiber extends and sticks to an escalator step, leaving a glistening trail.
rawScenePlan.videoPrompt: 2s shot: close-up as catalogue slivers pulse once, a single fibrous strand lashes out and slaps onto the escalator step; the strand quivers like a tendon, darkening the step where it touches.
rawScenePlan.cameraCue: After the pulse, whip-pan along the wet strand toward the escalator to follow the trail.

rawScenePlan.title: Hazard Ribbon
rawScenePlan.event: Small laminated strips peel free from the damp fibers and float like tradeshow tokens; as they spin they release a pearlescent vapor. The vapor clings to glass display cases and bends reflections into soft, undulating waves, leaving an iridescent ribbon that curls up toward the mezzanine.
rawScenePlan.consequence: A curling iridescent vapor ribbon climbing toward the mezzanine and a fogged, rippled glass case.
rawScenePlan.nextHook: the vapor ribbon reaches shoppers on the ground floor and brushes their hands
rawScenePlan.stillPrompt: Mid-shot of glass display cases as tiny laminated strips peel off fibrous strands and rise; a pearlescent vapor unfurls into a narrow, iridescent ribbon that fogs and warps the case reflections.
rawScenePlan.videoPrompt: 3s slow-motion: laminated strips detach and spin; a thin pearly vapor unfurls and flows along the glass, rippling reflections and curling upward into a ribbon toward the upper floor.
rawScenePlan.cameraCue: After the strips take flight, push in through the fogged glass to reveal the curling vapor ribbon.

rawScenePlan.title: Mannequin Cadence
rawScenePlan.event: The vapor ribbon brushes passing shoppers; their motions lock into a sudden, synchronized choreography—hands move in unison placing goods into a single, ordered procession. One shopper's basket tips and rolls, dropping items that line themselves into a tidy path pointing at a gap in the mezzanine railing.
rawScenePlan.consequence: A neat trail of aligned products leading up to a ragged gap in the mezzanine railing; a rolling basket stopped mid-path.
rawScenePlan.nextHook: the aligned trail hits the mezzanine railing, then bursts outward, enlarging the gap
rawScenePlan.stillPrompt: Crowd-level view: shoppers' motions become mechanical as their hands move in precise choreography, placing products into a single straight line; a wicker basket rolls and dumps items that fall perfectly into the trail toward the mezzanine gap.
rawScenePlan.videoPrompt: 2s rapid cut: close-ups of synchronized hands aligning products into a trail; a basket rolls and tips; camera follows the trail up to the mezzanine railing where a small gap waits.
rawScenePlan.cameraCue: After the alignment completes, dolly forward along the trail of products toward the ragged gap in the railing.

rawScenePlan.title: Through the Ragged Hole
rawScenePlan.event: The neat trail erupts: packaged goods launch outward in a sudden kinetic burst, shattering a section of mezzanine railing into jagged shards and widening the hole. From that ragged breach a pale creature slips through—tall, jointed limbs like ladders, semi-translucent membranous skin, glassy blank eyes and a mouth that parts to reveal rows of fine, paper-thin teeth. It slides onto the mezzanine riding the debris wake as store lights strobe and reflections fracture.
rawScenePlan.consequence: An enlarged, jagged hole in the mezzanine railing; scattered shattered goods and the creature perched half-emerged, casting a long shadow over the wreckage.
rawScenePlan.nextHook: the creature begins to touch the scattered goods, and objects near its fingers change surface quality
rawScenePlan.stillPrompt: Moment frozen: merchandise exploding outward and a pale, lanky creature sliding through a jagged gap in the mezzanine railing; strobing store lights catch on glassy eyes and membranous skin, shards suspended midair.
rawScenePlan.videoPrompt: 5s kinetic sequence: sudden launch of packaged goods like a controlled blast; railing splinters to a ragged hole; the creature moves fluidly through debris, perches on the broken rail, studies the floor below as strobes fracture reflections.
rawScenePlan.cameraCue: After the burst, low-angle push-in from below to silhouette the creature in the ragged hole and reveal its shadow stretching over the wreckage.

rawScenePlan.title: Market of Coins
rawScenePlan.event: The creature methodically touches scattered objects; each contact transforms the object into a single, shiny coin that clinks free and rolls. Coins collect into small tidal flows that stream back down aisles and into the filing-drawer architecture from the opening in scene 0, refilling drawers with cold metal. Frozen shoppers remain in place as currency quietly carpets the floor toward the exit.
rawScenePlan.consequence: Drawers partially refilled with neat piles of coins; a narrow, glinting coin trail leading toward the exit, shoppers still motionless.
rawScenePlan.nextHook: a thin, continuous coin stream leads out the front doors, suggesting an ongoing flow
rawScenePlan.stillPrompt: Close-up: the creature's fingertip touches a broken toy and it snaps into a single shiny coin; coins clink and roll into a pile that spills toward a half-open filing-drawer being refilled.
rawScenePlan.videoPrompt: 2s sequence: the creature touches several items in sequence; each contact yields a bright coin that rolls away and joins a growing stream; camera follows the coin stream as it spills into the drawer and then moves toward the exit.
rawScenePlan.cameraCue: After the conversion sequence, top-down pan following the coin stream as it flows into the drawer and then glides toward the exit.
